title: What's new in v2.6.3
summary: Hover one chart and the rest follow, targets can be renamed in place, DNS answers from any vantage, and a stuck modem can be nudged back onto 5G.

steps.title: Latency & Packet Loss
steps.listLabel: Hover one chart, read the same instant on all of them
steps.body: Point at any chart and the rest follow - same instant, same crosshair. Reading a spike against what the link was carrying no longer means lining up two charts by eye. **Device Stats**, **SFP Stats**, **CM Stats**, **ONT Stats**, **Cellular Stats** and **Starlink Stats** do it too.

steps.title: Latency Targets
steps.listLabel: Rename a Latency / Loss Target without removing it
steps.body: A target's name is now editable in place - click the pencil beside it.

steps.title: DNS Lookup
steps.listLabel: Test DNS from any device on your network
steps.body: **DNS Lookup** asks any vantage to resolve a name and names the server that answered. That separates a DNS failure from a routing one, and shows when something other than your resolver is replying.

steps.title: Reset Radio
steps.listLabel: Get 5G back without rebooting the modem
steps.body: When your modem is on LTE and won't come back to 5G, **Reset Radio** cycles the radio in about seven seconds to find a tower that offers it. It appears only when that's actually the cause.
